fileInventory.hashPolicy: All selected blobs except this self-referential manifest are SHA-256 pinned; the final Git tree identifies every blob, including this manifest.

knownLimitations.performance: Local controlled benchmarks only; extremely small Maintainer baseline; no SLA or complete provider latency. Designer measured approximately 0.5 ms additional local SSR.
knownLimitations.readability: Designer 20–30 second heuristic, not a timed human study.
knownLimitations.runtimeCapturePolicy: Private operational archives remain outside Git/public roots; frozen public R2/test fixtures are the explicit reviewed exception.

rollback.operational: Keep V2_SHADOW=OFF; V1 return path preserved.
rollback.visual: DashboardRegimeV1 remains the public component; V2 internal preview defaults to V1 and is unavailable in production.

executionConstraints.commitMessage: feat: add Regime Engine V2 release candidate

postCommitProtocol.identity: Read RELEASE_COMMIT=HEAD, RELEASE_TREE=HEAD^{tree}, PARENT_COMMIT=HEAD^ after the single commit.
postCommitProtocol.criticalHash: Recompute critical-manifest file hashes directly from commit objects and require exact match.
postCommitProtocol.verification: Fresh exact commit checkout, full candidate golden/R2/attacks/V1/V2/typecheck/build; compare results with precommit. Stop on any changed result, no second commit.
postCommitProtocol.output: local/postcommit/ (ignored; includes identity, reproduction, residual inventory and full staged audit)
postCommitProtocol.residuals: Candidate paths must be clean; keep and classify all excluded legitimate unrelated/evidence files.
